title: Recommendation
description: An Engine 2 (CDS) recommendation. Output is REFERENCE MATERIAL — explicitly NOT clinical advice. Every recommendation must trace to an explicit evidence chain and carry a Non-Device CDS attestation. UNMIRI emits Recommendations under the FDA's Non-Device Clinical Decision Support criteria: time-non-critical, publicly-available evidence, transparently explained, clinician-verifiable.

recommendationId.description: Stable UUID for this recommendation within this NGS interpretation response.

recommendationType.description: Category of recommendation. Drives downstream consumer routing (UI grouping, alert priority, etc.).

triggeredBy.description: FindingRef list — Variants, Biomarkers, or other findings from the parsed report that triggered this recommendation. The CDS engine emits one Recommendation per (rule, finding-set) pair.

evidenceChain.description: Ordered evidence chain backing this recommendation. May be empty for an evidence-gap recommendation. Each link cites a knowledge-base source, level, and resolvable URL so the clinician can independently verify per the Non-Device CDS attestation.

confidence.description: Model-internal confidence on a 0-1 scale. Surfaces uncertainty without claiming clinical authority.

priority.description: informational: nice-to-know. advisory: warrants clinician review. safety-critical: e.g., known severe drug-drug interaction, hereditary cancer finding requiring counseling referral.

narrative.description: Paraphrased natural-language explanation. Generated by Engine 2's LLM explainer (gpt-4o-mini) under strict constraints: no clinical advice language, no 'you should', cites every fact in evidenceChain. When the LLM is unavailable, a deterministic templated narrative is produced from the rule + evidence chain.

ruleId.description: Stable identifier of the rule that emitted this recommendation. Useful for downstream rule-tuning telemetry.

associatedDrug.description: Optional drug context (when relevant). Same shape as CdxFlag.drug.

kbSource.description: Origin knowledge base. Must be from the licensing-cleared set the engine ships with.

evidenceLevel.description: KB-native evidence level (e.g., CIViC 'A', ClinVar 'criteria provided, multiple submitters', AMP/ASCO/CAP 'I-A'). The Engine 2 LLM explainer prefers paraphrased framework-level summaries over reproducing the literal level descriptions.

citation.description: Citation identifier (PMID, DOI, NCT id, openFDA application number, CPIC guideline id, etc.).

url.description: Resolvable URL for the clinician to independently verify the evidence.

summaryShort.description: Optional one-line paraphrased summary of what this evidence link establishes. Never reproduces verbatim text from the source.

timeNotCritical.description: Recommendation does not require time-critical decision-making. UNMIRI Engine 2 always emits true; we do not target ICU or other time-critical contexts.

publiclyAvailableEvidence.description: All cited evidence is from publicly available sources (CIViC CC0, ClinVar, openFDA, CPIC CC BY 4.0, ClinicalTrials.gov, peer-reviewed literature). UNMIRI Engine 2 always emits true; the engine has no licensed proprietary KB inputs.

transparentlyExplained.description: Recommendation is accompanied by a transparent explanation tracing logic and evidence — the narrative + evidenceChain together. UNMIRI Engine 2 always emits true.

clinicianCanVerify.description: Recommendation includes resolvable citations so the clinician can independently verify before any action. UNMIRI Engine 2 always emits true.
